# Banner

The critical message shown when a payment fails. It opens by pushing the content below it down, drops in 8px with the spring curve, and takes focus so it is announced. The checkout has only this one tone.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/banner)

## Usage

```tsx
<Banner open={paymentFailed} title="Your payment didn’t go through.">
  Try again or use a different payment method.
</Banner>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether it is shown. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Bold lead-in. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The rest of the message. |
| `focusOnOpen` | `boolean` | Scroll it into view and focus it when it opens. Default true. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Banner.module.css`
- `Banner.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/lib/motion.ts`](../../lib/motion.ts)
- [`src/primitives/Collapsible`](../Collapsible)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
